The celebrations

Our story

We met on a stalled Third Mainland Bridge at 7:40 on a Tuesday morning, two lanes apart and both already late. Tunde offered a bottle of water through the window. Ngozi accepted it and, more importantly, kept the number written on the label.

Six years, one relocation and a great deal of arguing about jollof later, we would like you with us in December — for all four days of it.
